comment: Had her for Core, actually loved the course.  If only every professor cared as much about his/her students as Professor Mitric does...

I think she's a really nice woman, a little spacey, and a bit of a tough grader but you get the grade you deserve, i would say outside help is necessary, but dont shy away form this class just because of her, shes a good teacher

I don't care for her at all. She tries to be funny and make pop-culture references, but instead of being cool she is just annoying. She goes off on random topics that are a waste of time. I know that sometimes time-wasters are a plus but she does it so much that the class will not get anything done. My class was always far behind every other class.
she is awesome, random, and normally late so you can be late too!

An excellent professor, who challenges her students to think outside the box.  Very tough grader (but fair).  She gives excellent feedback on all papers/quizzes. Never even get to all the readings in class because class discussions go in different directions (which makes for a very entertaining class).  She's very liberal and speaks her mind!

Exactly what a college course should be: demanding, stimulating, rewarding. She does a great job guiding discussion (and getting off track) and really has a lot to share. Definitely take a class with her it will be worth it as long as you aren't a total jack ass.
Very smart woman but kind of spacey. Gets side-tracked and tells funny stories. I found her entertaining. Pretty demanding, hard but fair grader. Recommended

Passionate about the subject matter and knowledgable about the various topics. Very open minded towards student opinions. Pretty hard grader. Must do the work and think independently if you want to do well.

I had Mitric for Core and Leadership. She is definitely a hard grader on papers, but there are never reading quizzes, and discussion is normally interesting, and she is pretty funny. It's not a breeze class though (however no tests except midterm/final) and she rarely puts people on the spot during discussion. She is definitely entertaining.
great class, she makes it all worthwhile and relates every concept to modern day situations extremely well.
Such a cool lady...gets a little side tracked at times, interesting class anyways though. Highly recommend!
